transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I want to discuss the upcoming Northstar and Mosaic ERG forums. As you know, both groups have separate monthly forums scheduled for the same week coming up, and attendance has declined at both since they began sharing several company-wide initiatives. Before I consider approving any combined forum or temporary operating rules, I'd like to follow our standard practice: I'd like to go through a documented round where each ERG chair, HR business partner, and executive sponsor gets one uninterrupted turn to state any relevant concerns, constraints, policy requirements, or prior commitments. After that, I'll confirm the record with the group before making a decision. Does anyone want to kick us off?

Each ERG will preserve a separate confidential-intake channel during the combined forum pilot.
